build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameter sweeps and search params
add_static_bar: create a static bar body in the PHYRE scene with configurable angle, scale, and position
add_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar body in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_relationships: define a PHYRE task goal by setting spatial relationships like TOUCHING between two bodies
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task solution tier metadata using set_meta with SolutionTier.BALL
